source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.

Walls modeled as representative midplanes: exterior 240mm at outer faces 0-15 x 0-8; 1F corridor walls 250mm (midplanes y=4.9039/3.1286, clear 1.50m per left chain 3000/250/1500/250/3000 and drawing); 2F corridor walls 120mm (midplanes y=5.0054/3.0054, clear 1.88m per drawing); interior partitions ~120-130mm at drawn midplanes x=5.0/10.0 (1F), x=7.5 (2F north), x=3.804/7.5/11.315 (2F south)
Floors: F1 z0-3.0, F2 z3.0-6.6 per elevations (6600 total)
Window z: F1 sill 1.0 h1.6; F2 sill 0.8 (abs 3.8) h1.8, per all four dimensioned elevations
Door heights 2.1m (exterior doors ~2.0-2.2m measured on South/West elevations; interior assumed)
Room uses: offices/meeting rooms per furniture; 7 physical spaces per floor match declaration thermal_zones=7 per floor (declaration field is simulation zoning, not authoritative room count)

unresolved: 1F right chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940) conflicts with drawn 1F corridor (clear ~1470, walls 250); left chain + drawing used
2F corridor wall thickness: drawing 120mm/clear 1880 vs both 2F chains 340-400mm/clear 1200; drawing followed, centerline y=4.0 agrees with chains' corridor-center and windows
1F top chain sums 14760 (not 15000); window W_N3 kept at drawn pixels
2F north window W2_N2 drawn ~140mm east of top chain; south partitions drawn 3.80/11.31 vs chain 3.75/11.25
No staircase on either plan: vertical circulation unrepresented
West elevation horizontal chain labels 1F opening 1200 but plan/drawing show ~1500 entrance door; plan followed
Original prior candidates candidate_01 (F1 only) and candidate_02 (F2 only) are superseded by this combined two-floor proposal

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
